Adi Agashe's Bio

Aditya Agashe is a co-founder and CEO of Fiber AI, a Y Combinator backed startup that is automating outbound sales workflows using AI. He was selected by Forbes 30 under 30 in the Class of 2024, and is the author of 3 bestselling technology strategy books, including Swipe to Unlock. He has been featured in the Wall Street Journal, Forbes, Business Insider, Inc., and more. He was a prominent Product Manager at Microsoft, where he worked on the Azure cloud growth team to build hyper-converged and hybrid features that help customers adopt cloud technologies.
